text: The Schröder–Bernstein theorem concludes |A| = |B| from which hypothesis?
choices: A surjection A → B together with a surjection B → A
An injection A → B together with an injection B → A
A bijection between 𝒫(A) and 𝒫(B)
explanation: Two injections in opposite directions suffice to construct an explicit bijection, with no appeal to the axiom of choice. The two-surjections version also yields |A| = |B|, but extracting injections from surjections requires choice.
